  • Disponibilidade e flexibilidade de horário para cobrir eventos e jogos online, em especial durante a Copa do Mundo.

title: Forensic Manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.


Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.


Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.


In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.


To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.


While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.

Backed by private equity, the company's software features span website conversion, sales enablement, service offers management, retention marketing, and communication through the lenses of valuations, payments, inventory merchandising, and video.

title: AI & Innovation Experience Designer
description:
AI & Innovation Experience Designer


About the Role

We are seeking an AI & Innovation Experience Designer to help define the next generation of intelligent commerce experiences. This role will focus on conceptualizing and designing new AI-powered capabilities and hyper-personalized shopping journeys for a large-scale digital marketplace platform.


You will own the AI Tools and Hyper-Personalization workstreams, exploring how generative AI, advanced data models, and intelligent systems can transform how customers discover products, interact with sellers, and navigate digital retail environments.


This role requires a designer who is comfortable operating in ambiguity and enjoys shaping 0-to-1 product concepts. You will translate emerging technologies into compelling user experiences through prototypes, concept designs, and future-state product visions.


What You’ll Do

  • Conceptualize new AI-powered commerce experiences across search, discovery, and personalized shopping journeys.
  • Design innovative features powered by generative AI and machine learning, such as contextual search, personalized product detail pages, AI-generated retail media, and intelligent seller tools.
  • Explore how data and personalization models can create dynamic, hyper-personalized user experiences throughout the shopping lifecycle.
  • Develop concept prototypes and design explorations that communicate future product possibilities and inspire product leadership.
  • Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and data teams to translate AI capabilities into meaningful user experiences.
  • Present forward-looking concepts and design narratives to stakeholders, helping shape the long-term product vision.
  • Operate within a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles and evolving requirements.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product design or UX design, with exposure to emerging technologies or innovation-focused work
  • Experience designing AI-powered or data-driven product experiences
  • Strong conceptual thinking and ability to design future-state product concepts
  • Ability to communicate complex ideas through prototypes, visual concepts, and design storytelling
  • Understanding of personalization systems, recommendation engines, or conversational AI patterns
  • Comfort working in ambiguous, early-stage product environments
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Ability to work effectively in fast-paced consulting environments


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing GenAI-powered features, including conversational interfaces, AI search, content generation, or recommendation systems
  • Familiarity with retail media platforms, seller tools, or marketplace ecosystems

title: UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer
description:
UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer


About the Role

We are looking for a UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer to help improve the performance of a large-scale digital commerce platform. This role focuses on identifying friction in critical customer journeys and delivering usability improvements that directly impact conversion.


You will own the Usability workstream, partnering closely with product and analytics teams to analyze user behavior, uncover drop-off points, and design improvements across key transactional flows such as cart, checkout, and payment.


This role is ideal for a designer who combines strong UX thinking with analytical rigor and enjoys working in fast-moving consulting environments where rapid insights and quick wins are highly valued.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead usability analysis across critical customer journeys including product discovery, cart, checkout, and payment.
  • Conduct funnel analysis to identify friction points and conversion drop-offs throughout the purchase process.
  • Partner with product and analytics teams to analyze quantitative data such as conversion rates, abandonment points, and user behavior patterns.
  • Map end-to-end customer journeys to identify quick wins and usability improvements that can drive immediate conversion gains.
  • Design and prototype improvements to transactional flows, focusing on reducing friction and simplifying the purchasing experience.
  • Present insights and design recommendations to stakeholders, clearly tying usability improvements to measurable business impact.
  • Work within a fast-paced consulting team delivering iterative improvements across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in UX design or product design
  • Strong experience with data-driven design approaches, including funnel analysis and conversion optimization
  • Ability to collaborate with product and analytics teams to interpret quantitative data and translate insights into UX improvements
  • Experience mapping end-to-end user journeys and identifying usability improvements
  • Proven experience redesigning transactional flows such as cart, checkout, or payment experiences
  • Strong problem-solving and research skills
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Comfort working in fast-paced consulting environments with tight delivery timelines


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with A/B testing frameworks and experimentation programs
  • Background designing for marketplace platforms or high-traffic e-commerce products
  • Experience in consulting or agency environments with frequent stakeholder presentations
  • Familiarity with qualitative usability testing methods, including user interviews and moderated testing


This role offers the opportunity to combine UX design and analytics to drive measurable improvements in customer experience and platform performance. If you enjoy solving complex usability challenges and turning data into impactful design decisions, we’d love to hear from you.

Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

About the role

  • The Lead Finance Systems (Oracle NetSuite) Specialist is responsible for leading end-to-end ERP integration projects for newly acquired companies.


  • This role focuses on migrating legacy financial systems into a centralized Oracle NetSuite environment and ensuring alignment with standardized financial processes.


  • You will oversee discovery, configuration, migration, and post-go-live support with minimal oversight.


  • Working closely with finance leadership and operational teams, you will ensure data integrity, compliance, and successful adoption of the new systems.

  • Lead end-to-end migration projects for newly acquired companies, including legacy ERP data migration and system configuration.


  • Conduct discovery sessions to understand current-state processes and design future-state configurations within Oracle NetSuite and connected tools.


  • Create and manage project plans, timelines, risks, and deliverables, ensuring on-time and high-quality execution.


  • Coordinate the migration of chart of accounts, vendors, customers, transactions, and ledger balances from legacy ERPs into NetSuite.

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Software Architect (.NET)
description:

- Pesquisar, testar e engajar a adoção e disseminação de novas tecnologias e padrões de solução;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de novos produtos;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de projetos de APIs;

- Definir métodos de integração entre sistemas legados e novos projetos;

- Apoiar no desenvolvimento técnico dos demais integrantes da equipe.


Habilidades Técnicas:

- Experiência sólida em arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Domain Driven Design, Microsserviços, Component Driven Design, etc.);

- Domínio de práticas DevOps e CI/CD, com pipelines automatizados para back, front e mobile (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Bitrise, App Center);

- Vivência com Cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP) e provisionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC);

- Experiência em .NET e desenvolvimento backend escalável, com padrões arquiteturais e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka);

- Capacidade de aplicar padrões e boas práticas de engenharia de software (SOLID, Design Patterns, Clean Code);

- Experiência com contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);

- Conhecimento em testes automatizados e estratégias de qualidade (unitários, instrumentados, end-to-end, testes de performance);

- Vivência com monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas (Application Insights, Jaeger, Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry);

- Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações (OWASP, autenticação multifator, antifraude, segurança mobile/web);

- Atuação com sistemas distribuídos e integração com APIs REST/GraphQL;

- Habilidade em liderar decisões técnicas, avaliar riscos e suportar múltiplas squads em ambientes ágeis.

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Gympass - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: Cybersecurity Project Manager
description:
The Project Manager in our cybersecurity/IT services division will lead the planning and execution of complex technology projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget . This role acts as a bridge between technical teams (network/security engineers, developers, analysts) and business stakeholders. The Project Manager is responsible for coordinating cross-functional efforts in a dynamic environment, often managing multiple projects or client engagements simultaneously, aligning them with strategic goals and the latest industry practices (e.g., Agile methodology, cloud deployments, security compliance ).

Key Responsibilities:

  • Project Planning & Execution: Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables for cybersecurity and IT infrastructure projects. Develop detailed project plans with timelines, milestones, and resource allocation. Manage the full project lifecycle from initiation to closure, adapting to changing requirements or priorities.
  • Team Leadership & Coordination: Lead cross-functional teams (security engineers, IT staff, developers, client representatives) to ensure collaboration and timely task completion. Assign responsibilities, oversee day-to-day project activities, and maintain team motivation and productivity in both on-site and remote/hybrid work environments .
  • Budget & Risk Management: Manage project budgets and control costs. Identify and mitigate risks and issues proactively; implement contingency plans to address potential project roadblocks or security concerns. Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards and regulations (e.g., data privacy laws, security policies) throughout project execution.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary contact for internal and external stakeholders. Provide regular project status updates, performance metrics, and risk assessments to clients, senior management, and team members. Facilitate meetings, gather feedback, and manage expectations to maintain alignment with project goals and client needs.
  • Quality Assurance & Delivery: Ensure project deliverables meet the required quality and security standards. Coordinate testing, user acceptance, and security reviews on project outputs (e.g., new system implementations, policy rollouts). Oversee documentation (project plans, reports, compliance evidence) and obtain stakeholder sign-offs.
  • Post-Project Support & Continuous Improvement: Oversee transition of completed projects to operational teams. Conduct post-mortems and lessons-learned sessions to identify improvement opportunities. Stay informed on emerging industry trends (like AI integration in project management , DevSecOps , and new collaboration tools ) to continually enhance project management practices.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education & Professional Knowledge: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business (or related field). Strong understanding of IT systems, networks, and cybersecurity fundamentals to effectively communicate with technical teams and align projects with security best practices.
  • Project Management Skills: Proven ability to manage complex IT or security projects using project management methodologies (Waterfall and Agile). Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, or Trello) for planning, tracking, and reporting. Skilled in developing project documentation and managing project scope changes.
  • Leadership & Communication: Excellent leadership and organizational skills. Demonstrated experience coordinating cross-functional teams , managing resources, and resolving conflicts. Exceptional communication skills to interface with diverse stakeholders and present project updates in a clear, concise manner.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving: Strong risk assessment, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Capacity to anticipate challenges, craft mitigation strategies, and adapt to evolving project needs. Must be detail-oriented but also able to see the big picture to ensure projects deliver strategic value.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced Knowledge: Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, ISO 27001) and regulatory standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA) to integrate compliance into project plans. Understanding of modern IT trends such as cloud computing projects, digital transformation , or AI-driven solutions is a plus.
  • Industry Experience: Prior experience in an IT services or consulting environment , managing projects for external clients or within large enterprise settings. Background in network/security infrastructure projects or software development projects is advantageous.
  • Methodologies: Certifications or hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies (e.g., Certified Scrum Master) or DevOps/DevSecOps practices.

Experience Requirements:

  • Experience: 7+ years of experience in project management within the IT or cybersecurity domain. This should include successfully managing multiple full project lifecycles , with at least several projects related to IT security, networking, or software/IT infrastructure . Leadership experience in a matrixed or cross-functional team environment is essential.

Certifications:

  • Project Management Certifications: Project Management Professional (PMP) or PRINCE2 (highly preferred / required) as evidence of formal project management training and expertise.
  • Security/Technical Certifications: Certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) , Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) , or Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) are a plus, signifying an understanding of cybersecurity principles and compliance.
  • Agile/Other Certs: Additional certifications like Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or ITIL Foundation are beneficial and reflect a commitment to industry best practices.

title: Freight Desk Manager
description:
Position Scope

The Freight Desk Manager is a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on the LATAM region . This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities

  • Regional Strategy & Expansion: Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding.
  • Global Freight Desk Leadership: Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers.
  • Rate Card Governance: Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cards across a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency.
  • Strategic Sourcing: Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiatives for logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards.
  • Governance & Audit Architecture: Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments.
  • Control Tower Oversight: Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes.
  • Automation & Process Engineering: Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency.
  • Stakeholder Management: Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Experience: Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments.
  • Regional Expertise: Deep knowledge of the LATAM logistics landscape , including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks.
  • Procurement Mastery: Proven track record in leading RFQs and managing complex logistics supplier onboarding processes.
  • Network Management: Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and \"Control Tower\" operational models.
  • Technical Proficiency: Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments.
  • Leadership: Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field.
  • Languages: Fluency in English is essential for regional and global coordination.

Desirable Requirements

  • Advanced Education: MBA or Master’s degree.
  • Process Excellence: Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience.
  • Digital Transformation: Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools.
  • Rapid Growth Background: Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.g., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
Description

We are looking for a highly skilled Principal Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will lead architectural decisions and set standards for how we design, build and maintain our data platform and data-driven systems.

This is a hands-on role with no direct people management, but you will act as a strong technical reference, guiding others and driving initiatives that shape the future of our data ecosystem. You will work across data engineering and personalization use cases, helping transform raw data into actionable insights and intelligent user experiences.



Responsibilities

  • Make architectural and design decisions for our data pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring scalability, performance and long-term maintainability.
  • Write production-ready TypeScript code (AWS Lambda, CDK, Zod validation) to support data and backend workflows.
  • Design, build and maintain data pipelines using AWS services and databases such as Aurora, Snowflake and DynamoDB.
  • Develop and optimize ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform and load data efficiently.
  • Work with vector databases and embeddings to enable semantic search and personalization capabilities.
  • Apply personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation to improve data-driven user experiences.
  • Optimize data models and structures within Snowflake for cost-efficiency and usability.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy and consistency through validation, monitoring and testing practices.
  • Collaborate with engineers, analysts and product stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Review code, contribute to architectural discussions and mentor other engineers.
  • Continuously evaluate new technologies and methodologies to improve our data platform.



Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering or related roles. We are flexible for candidates with strong recent experience in AWS data pipelines and vector embeddings or personalization systems.
  • Strong experience with AWS services, especially Lambda, CDK and data-related infrastructure.
  • Experience writing production TypeScript.
  • Solid knowledge of Snowflake and relational databases such as Aurora or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines in cloud environments.
  • Advanced SQL skills.
  • Experience working with vector databases and embeddings for semantic search or similar use cases.
  • Understanding of personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation.
  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Experience with BI tools or big data technologies is a plus.



Profile Requirements

  • Strong technical leadership and ability to make architectural decisions.
  • Comfortable owning complex initiatives end to end.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally.
  • Proactive, hands-on and comfortable in evolving environments.

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
About IDP

At International Digital Partners (IDP) , we connect top global talent with fast-growing, innovative companies. We are a fully remote, multicultural team focused on delivering real value to our clients through technology, consulting, and digital execution. Our mission is to build world-class technical teams, and that’s where you come in.


About the Role

We are looking for a Technical Recruiter , highly experienced, self-driven, and multilingual, to join our international Talent Acquisition team. This is a key role in helping us scale technical teams across the U.S., Latin America, and Europe. You'll own full-cycle recruitment for high-demand technical roles.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the full recruitment life cycle for technical roles: intake, sourcing, interviewing, coordinating, and offer negotiation;
  • Screen and assess candidates, both on soft skills and basic technical fit;
  • Source talent proactively via Recruiter, referrals, and other sourcing platforms;
  • Maintain clear, professional communication in English and Spanish.
  • Build and nurture a pipeline of high-quality candidates across multiple regions and time zones;
  • Ensure a seamless, positive candidate experience from first contact to onboarding;
  • Contribute to process improvement and employer branding initiatives.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in technical recruiting, with proven success in international or remote hiring;

  • Fluency (B2) in English is a must; Fluency in Spanish is highly preferred but not required
  • Experience using ATS platforms (e.g., Manatal, Greenhouse, Bullhorn) and sourcing tools like Recruiter;
  • Ability to operate independently in a remote, fast-paced, multicultural environment;
  • Strong organizational and interpersonal skills, with a solution-oriented mindset.


Nice-to-Haves:

  • Background in tech consulting or staffing;
  • Experience hiring across LATAM, U.S., and Europe;
  • Knowledge of international hiring models (contracting, nearshoring, etc.);
  • Familiarity with Agile environments and distributed tech teams.


What We Offer

  • Fully remote, international working environment
  • Supportive, multicultural team and collaborative culture
  • Access to innovative global projects with high impact
  • Continuous learning and growth opportunities

title: Recruiting Coordinator
description:
The Recruiting Coordinator plays a critical role within the Talent Acquisition team at the client and is the convergence of all recruitment activity across the organization. This position is responsible for coordinating the logistics and execution of all recruitment activities at the client.


The Recruiting Coordinator is the front-line contact for all activity related to recruiting, and will work closely with a team of recruiters, hiring managers, the business line, external vendors, and candidates. The RC plays a key role in the talent acquisition team’s mission to ensure every candidate's experience in the job search process with the client is positive and meaningful.


Essential Skills Attention to detail: The RC needs to possess a strong eye for detail. The ideal candidate will create and own complex interview schedules that may include multiple locations, time zones and social mediums for conducting the interview (virtual and in-person).

It is crucial that the RC pays close attention to arrangements that often change, frequently at the last minute. In addition, the RC will draft important documentation (weekly reports, new hire paperwork, offer letters, proposals etc.) that have no margin for error.


Superior interpersonal skills: The ability to establish relationships with a broad range of individuals is critical. This position requires sound business judgment and maturity, and the ability to exercise appropriate discretion. The successful candidate will have a mature, professional, and polished demeanor. The RC will hold in the utmost confidence the details of every search process and protect the privacy of candidate personal data.


Intellectual Curiosity & Interest in Recruiting: The individual will have an active curiosity in recruiting, working with the broader talent acquisition team to assist in research, sourcing, candidate development, and a variety of talent acquisition related projects. In this regard, the CSS needs to demonstrate flexibility and a proactive demeanor


Responsibilities:

  • Provide recruitment support for a team of LoB recruiters including scheduling, coordinating, and facilitating in-person, phone, and video conference interviews
  • Create, collect, and compile feedback and manage briefing documents
  • Ensure data integrity and update candidate records in the applicant tracking system and HRIS as needed, including entering NDA documentation and relevant interview details
  • Manage logistics for the recruiting process, including travel arrangement, expense reimbursements, generating offer letters and ensuring background checks are 100% completed
  • Ensure every candidate experience working with the client is positive and leaves them feeling like they want to work here
  • Being the eyes and ears of the team, having the confidence to raise questions and make suggestions
  • Project based work across recruitment- we are enthusiastic about having a team member who has a growth mindset and is passionate about continuing to learn and evolve!


Requirements:

  • 1-3 years’ experience in an administrative, coordinator, client facing or customer service role
  • Ability to complete tasks with accuracy and speed
  • Eagerness to learn and the bravery to work through stages of ambiguity
  • Strong ability to handle confidential information with discretion and maturity
  • Superior organizational skills, detail-orientation, and the ability to prioritize workload independently
  • Ability to multi-task and work in a fast-paced, energetic environment
  • Excellent technology skills, specifically Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook
  • Experience with Workday and Jobvite is preferred Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • A collaborative mindset, the individual will be a team player, proactive and results driven

title: Senior Golang Engineer
description:
Please note that the project operates in the UK time zone.


We are seeking a dedicated, motivated, and reliable Senior Golang Engineer who is interested in providing innovative software solutions for our clients. Be a part of our team as we continue to deliver high quality products and services. The Senior Go Engineer will be responsible for building backend services in Go in EKS, as well as some Lambdas. The overall project will be centered around providing product data and managing the product life cycle. If you are an open communicator with a passion for learning, love to think outside the box and you are excited about software development, we are looking for you!


RESPONSIBILITIES

• Use your deep expertise in Go and related technologies to develop high-quality, scalable, maintainable software solutions.

• Make technically sound decisions and champion high standards of coding and architecture best practices.

• Develop and maintain software documentation such as technical specifications and design documents.

• Continually enhance the team’s performance by mentoring, code reviews, and improving current processes in the SDLC.

• Troubleshoot and debug software issues as they arise.

• Collaborate within a cross functional team and be able to transform both functional and non-functional requirements into actionable work.

• Manage communication of progress/status to stakeholders.


WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• At least 4 years of professional software development experience.

• Proficiency in Go (Golang), including syntax, semantics, database connectivity, and object-oriented concepts.

• Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms.

• Experience working with Go frameworks such as Gin, Revel, Echo, Beego, etc.

• Strong understanding of web services (HTTP, SOAP, REST, GQL, etc.).

• Terraform, Lambdas, Writing API’s.

• Strong working knowledge of relational databases.

• Experience in troubleshooting issues and root cause analysis.

• A proven track record of delivering high quality and tested software on-time and often.

• An open mind, and the patience to explain issues in a constructive manner.

• Strong communication skills, with at least an intermediate level of English.

• Experience working in distributed, cross functional teams.


NICE TO HAVE

• Kubernetes or EKS.

• Algolia.

• Shopify.

• DynamoDB


Who We Are?

We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.

title: Data Scientist - Sênior (Motor de Busca)
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na squad de Busca, com foco em Busca Semântica, relevância e ranking. Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução da experiência de busca, atuando desde a definição de hipóteses até a implementação, experimentação e mensuração de impacto, com forte interface com Produto, Engenharia e Negócio.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e evoluir soluções de Busca Semântica utilizando Elasticsearch, indo além da busca lexical tradicional.
  • Atuar na definição e otimização de: Estrutura de índices e mappings Estratégias de ranking híbrido (lexical + semântico) Queries semânticas (ex: embeddings, similarity search, boosting contextual)
  • Trabalhar com vetorização de conteúdo (produtos, termos de busca, atributos) para melhoria de relevância.
  • Avaliar e evoluir métricas de qualidade de busca. Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar impacto das melhorias semânticas. Traduzir problemas de negócio e experiência do usuário em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados.
  • Atuar em parceria com Engenharia e Produto na definição do roadmap técnico de busca. Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time, elevando o nível das discussões técnicas.


Requisitos necessários

  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins. Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados.
  • Experiência prática com Busca Semântica em Elasticsearch
  • Experiência com Information Retrieval (IR) e conceitos de relevância.
  • Conhecimento em NLP aplicado à busca (ex: embeddings, similaridade textual).
  • Experiência com modelos de ranking ou learning to rank.
  • Domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem.
  • Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto.
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume de dados. Noções de MLOps.
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.


Diferenciais

  • Vivência com BigQuery ou data lakes.
  • Experiência prévia em e-commerce, marketplace ou plataformas de discovery.
  • Experiência em observabilidade e monitoramento da qualidade da busca.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.


Perfil esperado

  • Forte mentalidade de produto e experiência do usuário.
  • Perfil analítico, curioso e orientado a impacto.
  • Autonomia para conduzir iniciativas complexas de ponta a ponta.
  • Capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas e de produto com dados.
  • Boa colaboração em times multidisciplinares.

description:

About Respond.io

Founded in Hong Kong in early 2017, respond.io is an AI-powered business messaging platform that helps companies manage customer conversations across chat, calls and email — all in one place.


Trusted by businesses in over 127 countries and recognized by G2 and SME100, respond.io enables fast-growing companies around the world to capture, convert, and retain customers at scale.


We operate as a globally distributed team with employees based around the world, contributing to a diverse and inclusive culture. Join us, and be part of a team that is shaping the future of customer conversation management!


Our Culture

At respond.io, we move fast, work smart, and always keep our customers at the heart of what we do. Here’s what we stand for:

  • Solve Customer Problems: Every effort must solve real customer pain points. No guesswork—just real feedback and clear value!
  • The 80/20 Rule: We focus on 20% of actions that create 80% of the value. Simple is powerful—it gets us moving fast.
  • 100% Alignment, 80% Accuracy: We aim 100% team alignment and 80% accuracy. Perfect plans can wait—clear goals come first.
  • Be Direct: We give honest feedback, and tackle problems head-on. Clarity moves us forward!
  • Own It and Support Each Other: We step up, help out, and drive outcomes—together.
  • Build Human Connections: Work is better when we trust, care, and celebrate wins together. We’re a team!


Role Description

At Respond.io, the role of Customer Success Manager is pivotal to our company's success. As a Customer Success Manager, you will be the go-to resource for top-tier customers to ensure successful product adoption and retention. This role entails handling clients onboarding, clients retention, and success planning.


Our ideal candidate will have the experience of working in a B2B SaaS company, and handling a fair share of different business processes. We are seeking someone who can ensure that our clients receive a great experience while working with us.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate closely with customers to understand their goals and help them maximize the value of the Respond.io platform
  • Assist customers during the onboarding process, ensuring a positive and smooth experience
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders
  • Act as a point of contact for customer issues and ensure timely resolution
  • Gain a deep understanding of customer needs, use cases, and objectives to ensure effective utilization of the Respond.io platform
  • Monitor and report on customer satisfaction and platform usage
  • Focus on maintaining high customer satisfaction and retention rates
  • Acquire in-depth knowledge of the Respond.io platform and identify opportunities for customer growth, collaborating with the internal team to propose upsells


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of B2B SaaS experience in Customer Success, Consulting, and Account Management
  • Experienced in working with international customers and handling global accounts
  • Attentive listener with an ability to address customer concerns effectively
  • Strong communication skills in Arabic and English to convey complex ideas clearly
  • Skilled in negotiating complex renewal contracts in a SaaS environment
  • Proficient in optimizing complex business processes
  • Familiarity with business messaging platforms, CRM systems, and Customer Success tools
  • Passionate about digital transformation and understanding diverse businesses
  • Ability to provide customer feedback and insights to various departments for product improvement
  • Deep understanding of our products, industry trends, and competition
  • Able to quickly grasp technical concepts and keen to become an expert in our software
  • An agile team player who is excited by the fast-paced start-up environment and is eager to make a difference


Here's what's in for you

  • You will become part of an amazing culture with smart, collaborative teammates who actually care about each other's growth and success.
  • You will grow more here than you would anywhere else, that is a promise.
  • Virtual events like talent shows, Among Us nights, and online game sessions to keep the fun going, no matter where you are!

  • Flexible working environment and working hours that fit your lifestyle, wherever you're based.

title: Research Engineer, Coding Agents
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Coding Agents to help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art coding models and software engineering agents for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their coding agent improvement goals into concrete data and environment specs — designing tasks that reflect real software engineering work and building the ground-truth systems that verify agent performance.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience, ideally combining strong software engineering fundamentals with exposure to ML/AI systems — especially where results depended on data quality, evaluation rigor, or building infrastructure that other engineers rely on.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and deliver datasets and RL environments for coding agents

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for coding agent capabilities: codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, test generation, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, and security fixes.
  • Design task suites that reflect real development work — single-step tasks (fix this bug, write this test) through long-horizon workflows (navigate an unfamiliar repo, diagnose a multi-file issue, produce a reviewed PR).
  • Build ground-truth signals: unit tests, structured checks, automatic validators, and reward functions that verify whether an agent's code actually works.
  • Define environment interfaces — repository structures, dependency contexts, tool schemas — that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build the quality and validation systems that ensure frontier-grade data

  • Perform deep, detail-oriented audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors, reward hacking opportunities (e.g., agents gaming test suites), leakage, and inconsistent assumptions.
  • Implement automated validation and filtering: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic task generation pipelines: programmatic bug injection, controlled perturbations to existing codebases, and scenario templating across languages and frameworks.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals aligned with coding benchmarks and customer-defined capability targets.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted coding tasks, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift on SWE tasks.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable coding agent improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, and large-scale data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in code quality metrics and automated signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for realism and correctness.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of professional software engineering or ML engineering experience.
  • Python proficiency required; proficiency in one or more additional major languages (C++, Java, Go, Rust, JS/TS) strongly preferred.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good coding task — realistic difficulty, clear ground truth, and resistance to shortcut solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented: you catch bugs in code that automated tools miss.
  • Experience with testing infrastructure, CI/CD, or code quality systems at a meaningful scale.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning model improvement goals into concrete task specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Experience building or evaluating coding agents, copilot systems, or AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with coding benchmarks (SWE-Bench, HumanEval, or equivalent).
  • RL or post-training work: RLHF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design.
  • Experience designing or maintaining evaluation harnesses for ML systems.
  • Comfort with SQL and structured data workflows


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.

  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

title: CRO & Shopify Developer
description:
CRO & Shopify Developer

  • Full time contractor
  • £22-32k per year (depending on experience).
  • Bonus structure on performance


About PM Digital

PM Digital is The full-funnel CRO & Performance agency for 7, 8, and 9-figure DTC brands. We optimise & fix entire funnels. Our focus is increasing profitability for ecommerce brands and you are part of this through the CRO split testing and Shopify development for our client stores.


About the Role

We're looking for a CRO & Shopify Developer to join one of our pods. You'll work alongside CRO strategists, designers, and copywriters to build high-converting landing pages, implement A/B tests, and bring Figma designs to life in Shopify.

This isn't a \"fix bugs and update plugins\" role. You'll be building conversion-focused pages from scratch, implementing split tests, and directly impacting revenue for DTC brands spending serious money on paid acquisition.


What You'll Do

  • Build landing pages, PDPs, and funnel pages in Shopify based on Figma designs
  • Implement A/B and multivariate tests using Convert.com and Intelligems
  • Set up price testing, offer testing, and bundle experiments via Intelligems
  • Work within our internal app and processes to ship work on time
  • Translate designer and strategist intent into pixel-perfect, fast-loading pages
  • Ensure all builds are mobile-first, performance-optimised, and QA'd before launch
  • Collaborate daily with your pod (CRO strategist, designer, copywriter)
  • Flag technical limitations or opportunities early — don't wait until it's a problem
  • Document your work clearly so others can maintain and iterate on it


What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years Shopify development experience (themes, Liquid, custom sections)
  • ADVANCED use of AI Within your development workflow. Speed is key.
  • Strong HTML, CSS, JavaScript — you can build from scratch, not just edit templates
  • Experience turning Figma designs into production-ready Shopify pages
  • Familiarity with A/B testing platforms (Intelligems, Convert.com, or similar)
  • Understanding of page speed optimisation and Core Web Vitals
  • Comfortable working async in a remote team across time zones
  • Strong written communication, you'll be working with non-developers daily
  • Attention to detail, sloppy work doesn't ship
  • Strong AI Use case to speed up time to delivery


What Success Looks Like

  • Pages go live on time, match the design, and perform well
  • Tests are implemented correctly the first time — no re-work loops
  • You proactively flag issues and suggest better solutions
  • Your pod trusts you to execute without hand-holding


You'll Thrive Here If You:

  • Want ownership, not tickets
  • Care about the outcome (revenue), not just the output (code)
  • Move fast and communicate clearly
  • Take pride in clean, maintainable work
  • Want to grow with a high-performance team


You Won't Thrive Here If You:

  • Need constant direction or detailed specs for every task
  • See QA as someone else's problem
  • Struggle with direct feedback
  • Don't hit deadlines


Details

  • Remote (European time zone based)
  • Full-time contractor
  • Salary based on experience - £22-34k BOE


How to Apply

Send a short note on why this role fits you, plus:

  • Link to 2-3 Shopify websites or experiences you've built (landing pages or custom work preferred)
  • Brief explanation of a test you implemented and how it performed (if applicable)


Fill in this form after the job role, you will get all your information here.

• Communication: Strong ability to present data findings in a clear, concise manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Advanced English

title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description:
Gemini Group (csigemini.com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.com


The Role

The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group.


In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations.


As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini’s M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini’s deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization.


Key Outcomes

  • Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals.
  • Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs.
  • Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini’s M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities.
  • Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams.
  • Support the long-term build-out of Gemini’s LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development.
  • Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal.
  • Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation.
  • Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit.
  • Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time.


Relevant Experience & Competencies

  • At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector.
  • Experience in outbound deal origination planning.
  • Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities.
  • Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development.
  • Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency.


Other Requirements

  • Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U.S., and Portugal.
  • Professional working proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required.
  • Professional working proficiency in Spanish is a bonus.

title: Senior AI Developer
description:
Senior AI Developer

Brazil

Senior AI Specialist


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a Senior AI Developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality software solutions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable and efficient software applications. Your role will involve leading technical projects, mentoring junior engineers, and continuously improving software development practices to ensure the delivery of robust and reliable software systems.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Design the interaction flow between different AI Agents (e.g., Diagnostic Agent triggers Optimization Agent);
  • Code the decision-making logic that interprets real-time data streams and triggers specific AI interventions;
  • Deploy and manage Gradient Boosting (XGBoost/LightGBM) and Neural Network models within Azure;
  • Utilize Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI / Prompt Flow to build conversational or reasoning capabilities for the advisor;
  • Orchestrate the interaction between physics-based models residing in Synapse and the AI layer;
  • Implement MLOps practices for model versioning, retraining, and drift detection;
  • Design and optimize system prompts for LLM-based components of the advisor;
  • Optimize inference latency to ensure real-time recommendations (sub-second response);
  • Expose AI capabilities via secure REST APIs for consumption by the UI/BI layer;
  • Ensure AI models comply with data privacy and security standards.

Essential Skills


  • Strong experience developing AI or machine learning solutions using Python;
  • Advanced knowledge of machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or Scikit learn;
  • Experience deploying and managing machine learning models including Gradient Boosting models such as XGBoost or LightGBM;
  • Hands on experience with Azure AI services such as Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service or Azure Machine Learning;
  • Experience working with data platforms such as Azure Synapse Analytics or Spark;
  • Familiarity with AI agent frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel or AutoGen;
  • Experience implementing MLOps practices including model versioning, retraining and monitoring;
  • Knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes;
  • Experience developing and exposing REST APIs to integrate AI capabilities into applications;
  • Strong problem solving skills and ability to optimize AI model performance and inference latency.

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

title: Event Operations Specialist
description:
About the job


Our purpose


ecoPortal health and safety engagement software helps organisations amplify workplace safety. We give leaders the data they need to create awe-inspiring safety cultures that ignite their team’s potential.


Engaged teams are the beating heart of industry-leading, odds-defying workplaces, and we’re committed to helping clients achieve that.


Our mission is simple: create engaged cultures and healthier environments for all.



Who we are


We’re a real Kiwi tech success story, built from the ground up with a vision of transforming the health and safety industry as we know it.


Through our years, we’re anchored by our commitment to championing people. That commitment begins from the ground up—with our own team.


Our team culture is an organic creation built by our people, for our people. Differences are celebrated here, and we firmly believe that our diverse lived experiences work together to make us stronger as a whole.



The Opportunity


The Event Operations Specialist provides hands-on support in the planning and delivery of ecoPortal’s sponsored and community events. Working closely with the Events Manager, Events Operations Specialist, Events Co-ordinator, and the wider Marketing team, this role helps ensure events are well-organised, engaging, and run smoothly from start to finish.


By seamlessly overseeing all aspects of event coordination—from initial planning through to post-event analysis—this specialist will play a pivotal role in solidifying and expanding ecoPortal’s influence and engagement globally.


This is a mid- senior role and would suit someone who is passionate about events, is unflappable in the face of multiple competing priorities, has the willingness to jump in and take charge of a large portfolio of events with a cool, calm head.



Key responsibilities


Event Management

  • Plan and execute successful sponsored events in NZ, AU and UK/EU. Full end-to-end management including but not limited to trade shows, conferences, lunches/dinner, awards.
  • Event management includes third party liaison, run pre-event briefings, manage swag, budgeting, logistics, and post-event analysis.
  • Execute full event debriefs at the conclusion of each event, and disseminate thai information to appropriate stakeholders for consideration. And, make recommendations for improvements and future attendance.
  • Collaborate with the Sales team for pre and event follow up and communications.
  • Work closely with the content and creative teams on all event related comms, branding, promotion, collateral and associated marketing.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (sales, customer success, marketing, and product) to ensure events align with overall business objectives and provide value to attendees.
  • Evaluate the success of events and report on key metrics, including attendance, lead generation, pipeline contribution, and ROI.


Community Engagement and Activation

  • Alongside the Head of Events, research the best H&S events in our target regions and recommend future events.
  • Lead ecoPortal's involvement in health and safety networks, infiltrating key communities, where applicable, attending industry gatherings, and establishing partnerships to strengthen ecoPortal’s reputation and presence.
  • Seek out bespoke opportunities for ecoPortal to participate in local, intimate, and partner industry events to increase brand awareness.
  • Develop and manage relationships with our prospects, customers and those in the Health and Safety industry and build a sense of community within ecoPortal’s customer base.
  • Develop and manage relationships with industry influencers, thought leaders, event organisers, and industry professional organisations.



Qualifications & Experience

  • A willingness and a passion to jump in and enjoy the sometimes hectic and unpredictable nature of events!
  • A Bachelor's degree in a suitable field (this may include, but is not limited to these majors) - Business, Marketing/Events, Management, Communications.
  • A minimum of 3 years experience in business events design and execution
  • Very strong organisational skills, you will be dealign with multiple events at any one time and this means you'll need to be an admin wizard.
  • Excellent attention to detail. Managing events across such a busy event calendar means honing in on details, and ensuring all your ducks are in line to ensure smooth execution.
  • Clear and confident communication skills, both written and verbal. With lots of balls in the air it's important that you know how to stay cool and calm, and focused on the task at hand.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment.
  • A proactive, can-do attitude with a willingness to take initiative. This is a senior role - and the expectation is that you'll be able to take ownership of a certain portion of events + mentor and guide others in the team who are more junior.
  • Team player with strong interpersonal skills and a customer-first approach.
  • Previous experience in events, customer service, or marketing is an advantage.
  • Comfortable using Google Workspace (Sheets and docs, and familiarity with marketing tools like Trello and Hubspot a bonus).



Perks & Benefits:

We hope that you're excited by the possibilities that come with working at ecoPortal! In addition to our welcoming and diverse culture, we also offer these fun perks and benefits.


37-Hour Work Week & Flexible Working: We prioritise work-life balance by offering a 37-hour workweek and flexible working arrangements. Some of your working hours will be aligned with the New Zealand time zone to ensure collaboration with the team.


⛺️ Generous Annual Leave


Birthday Perk: You get to take your birthday off! If it falls on a weekend, you can choose a day close to your birthday to celebrate. Milestone Birthdays are celebrated extra special with ecoPortal.


End-of-Year Celebration: Enter the draw for a chance to join the team at ecoPortal HQ in New Zealand for our epic end-of-year celebrations! The longer you’ve been with eP, the more entries you get. We've got flights, accommodation, and meals all covered while you’re here. ✈️ ️


Professional Development: ecoPortal offer financial assistance for Business English Language Courses, apps, or training.


❤️

title: Python Tech Lead - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Python Tech Leads to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Work closely alongside their Engineering and Business Stakeholders to support the delivery of the project.

- Be able to manage your time effectively to focus on coding as well as supporting junior members.

- Integrate with the DevOps team to maintain tasks.

- Make architectural decisions keeping the future of a growing business in mind.


Requirements:


- 7+ years of practical experience in Python and Django development.

- Experience in development with object-oriented programming is desirable.

- 3 years of development using other programming languages.

- Good skills with XML and relational databases (Oracle / MS SQL / MySQL).

- Experience with OOD.

- Strong professional experience working with large data structures (including XML) and algorithms.

- A University Degree in systems is a plus.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Blockchain Payments Coordinator
description:
InvesTec UAE is a forward-looking technology company operating at the intersection of fintech and blockchain innovation. We are focused on building efficient, scalable financial infrastructure powered by digital assets, enabling seamless global payments through blockchain technology.


As we expand our operations, we are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Blockchain Payments Coordinator to support and optimize our crypto payment processes. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the core of digital asset operations and contribute to the evolution of next-generation financial systems.


Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate daily blockchain payment operations, including transaction processing, monitoring, and tracking.
  • Assist in managing crypto wallets, ensuring accuracy in transfers and balances.
  • Support reconciliation of transactions across wallets, exchanges, and internal systems.
  • Monitor payment flows and identify discrepancies or operational issues.
  • Collaborate with operations, compliance, and finance teams to ensure smooth and compliant processes.
  • Maintain accurate records of transactions and prepare operational reports.
  • Assist in managing relationships with payment providers, exchanges, and blockchain partners.
  • Stay updated on blockchain trends, tools, and best practices to improve operational efficiency.


Requirements

  • 1–3 years of experience in crypto, blockchain operations, fintech, or payments coordination.
  • Basic understanding of blockchain networks, wallets, and cryptocurrency transactions.
  • Familiarity with stablecoins (e.g., USDT, USDC) and crypto exchanges is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to identify and resolve discrepancies.
  • Good communication skills in English; Portuguese is a plus.
  • Self-motivated and able to work effectively in a remote, fast-paced environment.


What We Offer

  • Competitive annual salary: BRL 180,000–220,000
  • Fully remote work with flexible hours across Brazil
  • Opportunity to gain hands-on experience in blockchain payments and digital asset operations
  • Exposure to cutting-edge fintech and Web3 technologies
  • Supportive and collaborative international team environment
  • Professional growth and learning opportunities in a rapidly evolving industry
  • Performance-based bonuses linked to operational accuracy and efficiency
